Stephen is an ancestor of Jerry (Stephen → Jack → Bruce → Ashley → Kelly → Anthony → Vincent → John → Stephanie → Jonathan → Jerry), and Pamela is also an ancestor of Jerry (Pamela → Douglas → Gerald → Thomas → Arthur → Zachary → Joseph → Rachel → Kevin → Gregory → Judy → Sandra → Susan → Dorothy → Kathryn → Elizabeth → Rebecca → Jacqueline → Cynthia → Debra → Philip → Jerry).  

So, Stephen and Pamela share a common descendant (Jerry).
